Research Services and Career Development
WELCOME
Research Services and Career Development
©
Violetta König
The Research Services and Career Development Office is the central service provider for researchers at the University of Vienna and, as such, supports both early-career researchers and established scholars in areas such as securing external funding, knowledge transfer, entrepreneurship, and social impact.
©
Ian Ehm
How We Work – Our Guiding Principles
We see ourselves as partners in research, going beyond administrative processes and formal requirements. Our mission is not only to help secure research funding and create favourable conditions for excellent research, but also to support the people who make research possible. We are particularly committed to helping shape an environment in which doctoral candidates and postdoctoral researchers can thrive, through training, professional development opportunities, and initiatives that foster their growth and open up diverse career perspectives.
We strive to be responsive, approachable, and reliable, taking ownership of challenges and working together to find solutions. We value professionalism, openness, and mutual respect, and believe that constructive collaboration begins with listening, understanding different perspectives, and treating each other with dignity. Above all, we believe that meaningful research support is built on trust, shared responsibility, and genuine human interaction.
Lucas Zinner (Head of Department)
